slug: 2025-11-19 Transform Africa Summit 2025 (Conakry) - Simandou 2040 Pillar 3, TELEMO, SANIA-SADX and the closing wrap

facts.fact: Guinea rolled out TELEMO, a national e-procurement platform from a Guinea-Rwanda South-South partnership, officially launched on 17 November 2025 on behalf of the Head of State, per Smart Africa.
